SELECT SUM(frl.quantity_returned) as units_returned
FROM fact_return_line frl
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON frl.product_key = dp.product_key
WHERE dp.subcategory = 'Garden Furniture'
  AND frl.return_date >= '2026-08-03'
  AND frl.return_date <= '2026-08-30'

SELECT 
  dp.product_name,
  SUM(frl.quantity_returned) as units_returned,
  COUNT(*) as return_lines
FROM fact_return_line frl
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON frl.product_key = dp.product_key
WHERE dp.subcategory = 'Garden Furniture'
  AND frl.return_date >= '2026-08-03'
  AND frl.return_date <= '2026-08-30'
GROUP BY dp.product_name
ORDER BY units_returned DESC

calls.statement:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT frl.product_key) as distinct_product_keys
FROM fact_return_line frl
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON frl.product_key = dp.product_key
WHERE dp.subcategory = 'Garden Furniture'
  AND frl.return_date >= '2026-08-03'
  AND frl.return_date <= '2026-08-30'

SELECT SUM(frl.quantity_returned) as units_returned
FROM fact_return_line frl
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON frl.product_key = dp.product_key
WHERE dp.subcategory = 'Garden Furniture'
  AND frl.return_date >= (SELECT period_start_date FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period = 4)
  AND frl.return_date <= (SELECT period_end_date FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period = 4)
